annotations.title: List choices for a workflow field

description:
The choices for one `ref` field of a node type, such as the phone numbers, agents or integrations in your account. Call it for every `ref` field and never guess an id. If it returns `400 no_options`, the field is not chosen from a list, so ask the user for the value.

(Tags: Workflows)

depends.description: The value of the field this one depends on (`depends_on` in the node type), such as the chosen phone number id.

node_type.description: A node type from `listWorkflowNodeTypes`, such as `whatsapp`.

name: listWorkflowFieldOptions
